Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can provide a sandbox export and an export mapping document. I've attached an updated SOW and quote that separates seats, Sequences, and the export project (SOW_v2.pdf). For multiyear commits we typically offer 15% for 2 years and 20% for 3 years — I included both options in the quote.

Technical notes (Amy copied):
- We support full CSV/JSON exports of Activities, Prospects, and Threads via our Exports API.
- Attachments are exported as links; we can include a packaged export for compliance teams.
- API rate limits are 500 requests/min for account-level exports; we can increase during a scheduled migration window.

Amy (SE) can run a sandbox export and walk your team through the mapping. If you can share a couple sample records or the completed migration checklist, Amy will validate the mapping within 48 hours.

Hi all — Amy from Outreach SE team here. Per Sanjay's note, we ran a short sandbox export for a mirror account last week; below are practical details and a suggested next step: 

Export details:
- Endpoints: /api/v2/exports/prospects, /api/v2/exports/activities, /api/v2/exports/threads
- Formats: JSON (nested), CSV (flattened). Threads include an attachments array (links to object store).
- Rate limits: we can temporarily raise to 5k/min for a scheduled migration window; will require a signed migration SOW line.

Suggested next step:
1) We will generate a 10k-record packaged export (zip) and put it on a secure S3 link for your procurement/compliance review.
2) Provide 10 sample prospect IDs (or a small CSV) and we'll run the mapping validation within 48 hours.
3) If you want Outreach to operate the export, we include a one-time migration fee (listed in SOW_v2).

Attachment: export-script.sh (script stub)

Team — after reviewing the SOW and options, here's my recommended path to keep timeline and control costs:

- Term: 12 months (2027-06-15 to 2028-06-14) with a 10% renewal credit applied to seat costs.
- Seats: cap at current 120 seats; add excess-seat credit so we can add seats intra-term at prorated cost.
- Migration: Outreach to run the one-time export; we will perform verification using the provided sandbox. Outreach migration fee accepted per SOW_v2 with the one-time line item.
- Compliance: Procurement needs SOC2 Type II artifacts and the packaged export link before issuing PO.
- PO target: procurement to issue PO by 2027-06-01 to meet the renewal date.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm with Outreach that 10% and seat cap are acceptable and ask Sanjay to remove the 2yr/3yr lines from the Doc so we have a clean 12mo SOW.
- Marissa: follow up with procurement for SOC2 review.
- Rishi: legal to review SOW_v2 once Sanjay returns the updated doc.

If Outreach pushes for a deeper discount for a 24mo term, we can revisit in the next 72 hours, but I prefer a 12-month path to preserve flexibility.
